span.p:
┌──────────────┬────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Term │ Key Point │
├──────────────┼────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ WAL │ Write-Ahead Log for crash recovery │
│ Dirty Ratio │ % of cache entries that are dirty │
│ Backpressure │ Throttle writes when buffer is full │
│ Flush Queue │ Ordered list of dirty entries pending flush │
│ Retry Queue │ Failed flush attempts waiting for retry │
└──────────────┴────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
